errors.text_span: Es sind vier durchgezogene Linien mit Kreis-Markern dargestellt
errors.evidence: In the figure, only the black and blue series use circle markers; the light gray and medium gray series also appear with circle markers, but the lines are not all described correctly as simply 'durchgezogen' with no distinction in style beyond color. More importantly, the plot uses no different line styles, so this is partly acceptable; however the black, gray, light-blue, and blue series have distinct shades and the description omits that the markers are present but not all line styles are differentiated. This is a weak fit rather than a clear error.
